description: NEW WORK — built 2026-10-27 for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon. Deterministic verified-brief gate: takes candidate tracks proposed by a caller (for example Muse Spark reasoning supplied by the caller) and returns the gate decision for each against the worker sync catalog data (sync-catalog-data.js, 29 tracks, 27 verified ISRCs). PASS only for a catalog match with a verified ISRC. FLAG for a catalog match without a verified ISRC. DROP for no catalog match (invented or outside the catalog). This tool makes NO Meta API call and holds no Meta key — Spark reasoning is supplied by the caller, the gate is the tool. A match is NOT a license — clearance is direct by Cumulative Web Inc, hp@cumulativeweb.com, one-signature, BMI.
